_comment: Hidden gifts (plan item 4756-4758, fan feature rank 6): one hidden gift per line, read by scripts/core/HiddenGifts.gd. 'lines' names a line's gift; a line without an entry gets the gift of its first element ('by_element'), so new species are covered at once. A gift uses the same effect keys as BattleRules.TRAITS. The informant Whisper Moll on Corvane Quay sells the tip that reveals a line's gift; sometimes she sells a stale tip (betray_chance) and only that fee is lost. A revealed line stays revealed. A Spirling of that line at unlock_ring or higher may wake its hidden gift and put it back to sleep at any time. The Fair League never uses hidden gifts.

smouldering_debt.label: Smouldering Debt
smouldering_debt.text: Scorch raises its Might, and it never dozes off on a job.

cold_ledger.label: Cold Ledger
cold_ledger.text: Can't be Scorched, and it mends a little each turn.

family_roots.label: Family Roots
family_roots.text: Mends a fair share of Vigor at the end of each turn.

hot_wire.label: Hot Wire
hot_wire.text: Gains 1 extra Energy each turn and can't be Jolted.

stone_alibi.label: Stone Alibi
stone_alibi.text: Takes 20% less damage from physical arts.

getaway_wind.label: Getaway Wind
getaway_wind.text: Can't be Rooted or Soaked. Nobody holds it down.

snitch_glow.label: Snitch's Glow
snitch_glow.text: Can't be Dazed or Drowsed. It sees everything.

last_laugh.label: Last Laugh
last_laugh.text: Its own element hits 40% harder below 1/3 Vigor.

old_debts.label: Old Debts
old_debts.text: Gains 1 extra Energy each turn. Someone always owes it.

prism_skin.label: Prism Skin
prism_skin.text: Very effective hits split in its skin: a double hit lands at x1.5.

countercurrent.label: Countercurrent
countercurrent.text: Swims against the last current: the element that hit it last lands at half.

tip_lines: Whisper Moll: Everybody has a secret. Spirlings too. Mine cost coins.
Whisper Moll: I hear things on the quay. Ropes creak, crates talk.
true_tip: Whisper Moll leans in: "The %s line hides a gift. %s." She is telling the truth, for once.
stale_tip: Whisper Moll sold you a stale tip. The same rumour is chalked on the harbour wall. She keeps the coins and waves.
